Stronger still, the owner ALREADY HOLDS Fresco, Voyager and several Huddersfield books coded to an old factory system, which turns the ask from "send me samples" into "help me make my existing books current" - costing Gladson nothing and proving existing activity.

suppliers.name: Fabricato
suppliers.notes: Colombia largest mill; weaves poplin, twill and wool; exports to US (US-Colombia TPA = 0% if yarn-forward). Evidence is a 2012 profile - current product lines unverified, and mill-scale MOQ likely. Park unless a distributor surfaces.

business_model.status: Operating. Producing through other manufacturers; customsuits.net in final design, launching shortly.
business_model.retail_band: $600-700 for the bulk of the work; ~$500 floor for a client worth winning; up to $1,500 at the top.
business_model.cloth_pricing: COST-PLUS PASS-THROUGH. Cloth is transferred to the customer close to transparently and sits on their invoice as its own line, rather than being absorbed into the garment price.
business_model.implication: Cloth cost does not come out of the making price, so "cloth as a share of retail" is the wrong frame. Premium cloth is sellable because the customer self-selects and carries the cost. The $15-30/yd tier is not margin protection - it is the house and entry cloth offer at the $600-700 core price.
business_model.existing_category: Most work is already in tropical and lightweight wools - the brief's central ask is the existing business, not a new category.
business_model.existing_books: Already holds a Fresco book, a Voyager book, and several Huddersfield books, coded through an old factory system whose references no longer map cleanly.
business_model.ambition: Building a more upper-range clientele; cloth is the lever.
business_model.volume: ~300 garments in the two years since opening (~150/year), projecting to double over the coming year on the back of the website launch, a planned social campaign, and the deliberate push upmarket.
business_model.address: 345 Taylor Rd, Dry Prong, LA 71423, USA (shipping). Alexandria, LA had been used in earlier correspondence.

stage_model.why: A tick meant "I reached out" and nothing more, so a supplier who replied and then heard nothing looked identical to one still being chased. Replaced with a stage per row on the call sheet rather than a second list - two lists mean double entry, and the first disagreement leaves you unsure which is true.
stage_model.canonical: The call-sheet artifact is where stages are set. sourcing/call-sheet.html is its source.

verified: SCOTUS struck down all IEEPA (reciprocal + fentanyl) tariffs 6-3 on 2026-02-20 (Learning Resources v. Trump); CBP stopped collecting 2026-02-24. [VERIFIED 2-1 and by refutation-pass cross-checks]
Replacement Section 122 surcharge ran at 10% (the announced 15% was never legally implemented - claim refuted 3-0) from 2026-02-24 and expired by operation of law 2026-07-24.

Since 2026-07-24: new Section 301 duties of 10-12.5% by country tier on ~60-80 economies replaced the surcharge; Brazil carries an additional 25% Section 301; Section 301 China List 3 (25% on woven fabrics) never went away.

De minimis ($800 duty-free parcels) suspended for ALL countries since 2025-08-29 (EO 14324), continued by EO 14388, codified in CBP regs 2026-06-24, upheld by CIT 2026-08-13, statutory repeal 2027-07-01. Every parcel now needs a formal or informal customs entry.
practical: MFN base: woven wool (HTS 5112) ~25%; cotton shirting (HTS 5208/5210) ~7-10%.

Duty-free lanes that actually work: USMCA Mexico and US-Peru/Colombia TPAs at 0% when yarn-forward origin is met and documented. Mexico has live wool mills (CIMEXLANA, Novalan); Peru has pima shirting (Creditex).
Turkey: NO FTA - wool lands at ~35%+ total. Morocco: FTA exists but no suiting/shirting weaving found (Settavex is denim, possibly defunct) - the FTA does not help in practice.
China: wool suiting effectively ~50% total duty (25% MFN + 25% Section 301) plus per-parcel entry/brokerage fees; 1m-MOQ Alibaba sellers at $9-17/m nominal lose most of their edge landed.
EU (Portugal/Italy): ~15% all-inclusive ceiling under the EU-US deal effective 2026-07-01 [LIKELY - single source].
Small-parcel math: entry + brokerage on a $70 cut-length parcel often exceeds the duty itself. Consolidate orders or buy domestic.
